Cash Offers
Let us watch the market for you!
Tama Benton uses Stonehedge, an offer management System. This enables us to work target offers for you. You tell us what price you would like and how may bushels. If the market reaches that level, your offer fills and we will write the check/contract. These offers are working even during the overnight.
